about_mission_body: Odyssey was born from the belief that a student's future should not be limited by geography, language, injury, family income, or access to a famous school. We are building a platform where determined learners can reach excellent teachers, strong exam preparation, and practical skills wherever they begin.
about_v1_body: Every course works offline. Every price is set in local currency. We compress videos for 3G networks because education cannot wait for fast internet.
about_v2_body: 70% revenue share. No arbitrary takedowns. instructors own their content and build real businesses on Odyssey.
about_v3_body: We actively recruit instructors who teach in local languages — Yoruba, Farsi, Swahili, Tagalog. A Öğrenci learns best in the language they think in.

about_in_2021_our_founders_noticed_somet: In 2021, our founders noticed something troubling: a Öğrenci in rural Nigeria had no access to quality JEE prep, while a Öğrenci in a tailoring workshop in Kolkata had no structured path to grow their craft. Both had the talent. Neither had the tools.
about_so_we_built_odyssey_a_platform_whe: So we built Odyssey — a platform where any Eğitmen, from any corner of the world, can teach anything; and any Öğrenci, regardless of location or income, can learn it. In their own language. At their own pace. Even on a slow connection.
about_today_we_re_12_million_students_st: Today we're 12 million öğrenci strong, spanning 190 countries. But we're just getting started. 🚀
about_text: Bu bölüm Odyssey’in misyonunu, değerlerini ve erişilebilir eğitim taahhüdünü anlatır.
about_every_feature_we_build_asks_does_t: Every feature we build asks: does this work for a Öğrenci on 3G in rural Kenya? If not, we go back to the drawing board.

about_we_launch_in_nigeria_india_and_the: We launch in Nigeria, India, and the UK with 12 instructors and 400 öğrenci. The offline-first mobile app and local-language support immediately resonate with users.
about_we_raise_18m_expand_to_40_countrie: We raise $18M, expand to 40 countries, and hit 500K öğrenci. The vocational catalogue — cookery, tailoring, agriculture — becomes our fastest-growing category.
about_odyssey_becomes_the_largest_global: Odyssey becomes the largest global exam-prep platform by Öğrenci count, surpassing 840,000 kurs. Our Arabic, Hindi, and Swahili catalogues each surpass 50,000 kurs.
about_we_re_building_ai_powered_personal: We're building AI-powered personalised learning paths, expanding live class infrastructure to 80 more countries, and launching the Odyssey Scholarship Fund for öğrenci in underserved regions.

earnings_subscription_body_html: Odyssey subscriptions are separate from course sale revenue. The Free plan lets instructors keep up to 5 active courses and 20 exams published. Pro is $15/month for solo instructors, with up to 25 active courses, 100 exams, richer student analytics, CSV exports, and priority review signals. Institutional is $40/month for schools and academies, with up to 100 active courses, unlimited exams, team workspace tools, certificate branding, and institution-level analytics.
earnings_subscription_note: Subscriptions do not reduce your 70% instructor revenue share on course sales. They unlock publishing capacity, analytics, and operating tools for larger teaching businesses.
terms_subscription_body_html: Instructor and institution subscriptions control publishing capacity and dashboard features. The Free plan includes up to 5 active courses and 20 published exams. The Pro plan costs $15/month and includes up to 25 active courses, 100 exams, advanced analytics, and exports for solo instructors. The Institutional plan costs $40/month and includes up to 100 active courses, unlimited exams, team workspace tools, certificate branding, and institution-level analytics.
terms_subscription_note: Subscription fees are billed separately from student course payments. If an account exceeds its plan limit, Odyssey may pause additional publishing until the account upgrades, archives courses, or reduces active exams. You may cancel or change plans according to the subscription settings available in your dashboard.
